items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: But it was Nelson who made that arrangements... one of those arrangements that you had with 'Snag It', made by, I think his name is Dave Nelson, I think.

ctx.x: He brought in Ben Whitted and he brought in me, see? But he didn't - I don't know what Charlie Irvis, I don't know what Charlie Irvis did any, maybe there. Because I think we had Cuffey, I remember Cuffey real well. Another guy that was there often that you must check on, the cousin of Joe Oliver, and he did the arrangement -
Dave Nelson, he was there, see what I mean? He was there -
